svg.title: Audio model network architecture
svg.desc: A two dimensional input, either a spectrogram for the scream model or a grid of recent loudness readings for the loudness model, passes through a Conv2D layer of 16 filters (5 by 5, stride 2), 2 by 2 max pooling, a Conv2D layer of 32 filters (3 by 3), 2 by 2 max pooling, a Conv2D layer of 64 filters (3 by 3, stride 2), global max pooling, a dense layer of 64 ReLU units, and a sigmoid output giving a 0 to 1 score. Curved lines show information passing between layers.
